defs.def: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different 同一的；相同的

ex.s: Art is deeply personal, because when two people see the same artwork, our perception can create vastly different experiences of meaning.
ex.t: 艺术是非常个人的，因为当两个人看到同一件艺术品时，我们的感知可以创造出截然不同的意义体验。

ex.s: This effect capitalizes on the fact that when people make errors, those errors aren’t always the same.
ex.t: 这种效应利用了这样一个事实：当人们犯错时，这些错误并不总是相同的。

ex.s: Four years ago they all moved into a three-storey Victorian house in Bristol — one of a growing number of multigenerational families in the UK living together under the same roof.
ex.t: 四年前，他们全都搬进了布里斯托尔一栋三层维多利亚式住宅——这是英国越来越多几代人同堂、住在同一屋檐下的家庭之一。

ex.s: They share the same start point.
ex.t: 他们有一个相同的起点。

ex.s: With so many online posts featuring the same places, it’s easy to feel like you’re missing out.
ex.t: 网上有那么多展示同一批地方的帖子，你很容易觉得自己错过了什么。

ex.s: The same nature experience takes different forms.
ex.t: 同一种自然体验可以呈现不同的形式。

ex.s: So in physics class on Monday, l did the same, but the teacher spoke so fast that l couldn't take everything down.
ex.t: 所以周一的物理课上，我也照做了，但老师讲得太快了，我都没来得及全部记下来。

ex.s: And speaking of home, why aren't homework and housework the same thing?
ex.t: 说到家，为什么家庭作业和家务活不是同一回事？

ex.s: Motivation and goal setting are the two sides of same coin.
ex.t: 动力和目标是同一枚硬币的两面。

ex.s: Professor Alex Davidson teaches the same course in person and online.
ex.t: 亚历克斯·戴维森教授亲自和在线教授同一门课程。

ex.s: ■On the same sheet of paper, write or type your name, address, telephone number, and birth date.
ex.t: ■在同一张纸上，手写或打印你的姓名、地址、电话号码和出生日期。

ex.s: The team discovered that some synapses seem to be protected and stayed the same size.
ex.t: 研究团队发现，某些突触似乎受到保护，保持了相同的尺寸。

defs.def: exactly like the one or ones referred to or mentioned （与 … ）相同的，一模一样的

ex.s: If harmless actions are the opposite of harmful actions, why are shameless and shameful behaviors the same?
ex.t: 如果无害的行为与有害的行为相反，为什么无耻和可耻的行为却是一样的？

ex.s: However, for maximizing learning where mental focus and reflection are called for, educators shouldn’t assume all media are the same, even when they contain identical words.
ex.t: 然而，在需要专注与思考、追求学习效果最大化时，教育者不应认为所有媒介都是一样的，即使它们包含相同的文字。

ex.s: And not all historical accounts are the same.
ex.t: 而且并非所有的历史记载都是一样的。

ex.s: If you are time poor, you need run for only half the time to get the same benefits as other sports, so perhaps we should all give 70      a try.
ex.t: 如果你时间紧张，你只需要花一半的时间就能获得与其他运动相同的收益，所以也许我们都应该____70____尝试一下。

ex.s: In fact, I got the same medal as the one that the guy who came in first place had.
ex.t: 事实上，我得到的奖牌和得第一名的那个人得到的一模一样。

ex.s: And I applied with the same anxious excitement as before.
ex.t: 我带着和以前一样既焦虑又兴奋的心情提交了申请。

ex.s: Is comprehension the same whether a person reads a text onscreen or on paper?
ex.t: 一个人在屏幕上读文章和在纸上读文章，理解效果是一样的吗？

ex.s: Ask the tourists from around the world that flood into Yellowstone National Park what they most hope to see, and their answer is often the same: a grizzly bear.
ex.t: 向来自世界各地的游客询问淹没进入黄石国家公园的游客最希望看到什么，他们的答案往往是一样的：一只灰熊。

ex.s: According to the experts, problems faced by people regardless of the past and present are the same.
ex.t: 根据专家的说法，人们无论在过去还是现在所面临的问题都是一样的。

defs.def: the same thing or things （和 … ）同样的事物，相同的事物

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

ex.s: Led by the concept of “right plant, right place,” they match plants that enjoy the same soil, sun and weather conditions, and arrange them according to their patterns of growth.
ex.t: 在“合适的植物，合适的位置”这一理念引领下，他们把喜好相同土壤、阳光和天气条件的植物搭配在一起，并按其生长模式排列。

ex.s: This was an aha moment for me, and I never thought about endings the same way again.
ex.t: 这对我是个恍然大悟的时刻，此后我对结局的看法再也不同。

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界，大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时，我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑，这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心，而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 同样地，我们多年来可能会背诵那些很久以前就烂熟于心的诗歌，它们已经成为我们自我认知的一部分。

ex.s: She often asks this, and I always answer the same way—“To have Granddad back” —which usually gets her reminiscing about him.
ex.t: 她常这么问，而我也总是同样的回答——“让爷爷回来”——这通常会让她陷入对他的回忆。

ex.s: If I asked what she had for lunch, she might say, “Oh, the weather has been lovely today. ” She seemed to recycle the same handful of answers to my questions.
ex.t: 如果我问她午饭吃了什么，她可能会说："哦，今天天气真好。"她似乎总在用同样那几个答案应付我的问题。

ex.s: Why did the author’s grandmother recycle the same answers to his questions? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 为什么作者的祖母总是用同样的答案回答他的问题？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: If people are similar and tend to make the same errors, then their errors won’t cancel each other out.
ex.t: 如果人们彼此相似并倾向于犯同样的错误，那么他们的错误就不会相互抵消。

ex.s: Head Chef David Thompson, who received a Michelin star for his Loodon-based Thai restaurant of the same name, opened this branch in the Metropolitan Hotel in 2010.
ex.t: 主厨大卫·汤普森曾凭借其位于伦敦的同名泰国餐厅获得米其林一星，他于2010年在大都会酒店开设了这家分店。

ex.s: Doing the same routine all the time.
ex.t: 一直做同样的常规训练。

ex.s: As an award-winning cookbook author, Ms Young, now 66, has spent decades shopping the same way in New York’s Chinatown.
ex.t: 作为一位获奖食谱书作者，现年66岁的杨女士几十年来一直以同样的方式在纽约唐人街购物。

ex.s: If the field of ALife manages to reproduce life’s endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly inventive machines.
ex.t: 如果ALife领域能够在某些虚拟模型中复制生命无限的"创造力"，那么同样的原理可能会催生真正具有创造力的机器。

ex.s: On the other hand, being young and old at the same time has its attractions.
ex.t: 另一方面，既年轻又古老也有其魅力。"

ex.s: As autumn comes, she gets restless—the same old wanderlust returning.
ex.t: 随着秋天到来，她变得不安分——那种熟悉的旅行癖又回来了。

ex.s: avoid making the same mistakes
ex.t: 避免犯同样的错误

ex.s: It's the best way to get rid of your used clothes, score clothes from your friends, and have a party all at the same time.
ex.t: 这是处理你旧衣服、从朋友那儿淘衣服、同时开个派对的最佳方式。

ex.s: Many students say they will talk to their friend or classmates because they're of the same age and can understand each other.
ex.t: 只有少数选择自己处理问题。

ex.s: I would go to the office, sit at my desk and repeat the same work five days a week 9 to 5.
ex.t: 我会去办公室，坐在我的办公桌 重复同样的工作 每周5天9到5。

ex.s: We all spoke the same language of passes and shots.
ex.t: 我不擅长足球，但那个晚上很美好。

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市Factoria大道上的交通信号，通常连续两次不会亮同样时长的绿灯，尤其在高峰时段。

ex.s: Then, for eight years, the scientists asked the same group to come back to the lab every 18 months to take the same sorts of tests.
ex.t: 然后，在8年的时间里，科学家们要求同一个团体每隔18个月返回实验室进行同样的测试。

ex.s: Want to explore new cultures，meet new people and do something worthwhile at the same time?
ex.t: 想探索新文化、结识新朋友，同时做点有意义的事吗？

ex.s: The report data shows that pleasure reading levels for younger children, ages 2-8, remain largely the same.
ex.t: 报告数据显示，2-8岁儿童的娱乐性阅读水平基本保持不变。

ex.s: Given a limited amount of money, a consumer can only spend that same amount buying goods.
ex.t: 如果消费者需要数量为A的商品花费0.75，那么她只能在购买B时花费剩余的0.25X。

ex.s: To understand this, think of a graph where the vertical lines quantify how many movie tickets. you can buy and where the horizontal lines do the same for crime novels.
ex.t: 要理解这点，想象一张图，竖线量化你能买多少电影票，横线对犯罪小说做同样的事。

ex.s: It has to continue to move, because the way the world works is not the same,” says Moran.
ex.t: “它必须继续发展，因为世界的运转方式已经不同了，”莫兰说。

ex.s: They were of the same age.
ex.t: 他们同龄。

ex.s: If everyone is giving you the same answer, you won’t be able to use it.
ex.t: 如果每个人都给你同样的答案，你就没法利用它。

ex.s: To get good and useful results, ask them the same question.
ex.t: 要想获得好的有用的结果，问他们同样的问题。

ex.s: They were of the same age.
ex.t: 他们同龄。

ex.s: They could do precisely the same thing to inspect railway lines and other vital aspects of rail infrastructure such as the correct position of railway tracks and switching points.
ex.t: 检查越频繁，铁路的安全性、可靠性和准点率就会越高。

ex.s: "Instead, our results suggest that the successful dogs realized that a smiling mouth means the same thing as smiling eyes, and the same rule applies to an angry mouth having the same meaning as angry eyes.”
ex.t: “相反，我们的结果表明，成功的狗意识到微笑的嘴和微笑的眼睛表达的是同一意思，同样的规则也适用于生气的嘴和生气的眼睛含义相同。”

ex.s: That’s bad news for the environment — and our wallets — as these outdated devices consume much more energy than the newer ones that do the same things.
ex.t: 对环境来说这是个坏消息——对我们的钱包也是如此——因为这些过时的设备比做同样事情的新设备消耗更多的能源。

ex.s: You can do the same thing when you are reading the text!
ex.t: 你在阅读课文时也可以做同样的事情！

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: This same dot appears at the extreme left above “0” on the horizontal axis because you have no money left for books — the number of books available in this example is 0.
ex.t: 这个点在横轴上“0”的最左端上方出现，因为你已没有钱买书——此例中可买的书数量为0。

ex.s: And are listening to and viewing content as effective as reading the written word when covering the same material?
ex.t: 在学习同样的材料时，听和看内容与阅读文字一样有效吗？

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: It fills more slowly, but all the same, it fills.
ex.t: 它注满得更慢，但同样，它会注满。

ex.s: You could not take back a book to the library on the same day you’d taken it out; it made no difference to her that you’d read every word in it and needed another to start.
ex.t: 你不能在借书当天就把书还回图书馆；即便你把里面每个字都读了、需要另一本开始读，对她来说也没区别。

ex.s: My reaction to the renewed reading no longer corresponded to the original experience, and I was no longer sure that I recognized myself as the same reader.
ex.t: 我对重新阅读的反应不再与最初的体验相符，我也不再确定我能认出自己是同一个读者。

ex.s: A city can be young and old at the same time.
ex.t: 一座城市可以同时年轻又古老。

ex.s: Mom was sure same color would look great on her.
ex.t: 妈妈确信同样的颜色在她头上也会很好看。

defs.def: having the same number, colour, size, quality, etc. （数目、颜色、大小、质量等）相同，一样

ex.s: They are of the same age.
ex.t: 他们年龄相同。

defs.def: the same person 同一个人

ex.s: Eva decided to use the same trick to deal with the school building.
ex.t: 伊娃决定用同样的方法来处理学校建筑的问题。

ex.s: As it turns out, however, this same concept-one that most consumers make many times each day with reflecting on it-is the basis of the more formal budget line concept in economics , which is explained below.
ex.t: 然而，事实证明，同一个概念——大多数消费者每天都会做出许多次、却不去反思的概念——是经济学中更正式的预算线概念的基础，下文将作解释。

ex.s: For the past ten years, my dad and I have attended the same school — he as an administrator and I as a student.
ex.t: 在过去的十年里，我和我爸爸在同一所学校上学——他是一个行政人员，我是一个学生。

ex.s: Not everyone acts the same in response to events, and that is why what triggers one person may or may not trigger another.
ex.t: 并非每个人对事件的反应都一样，这正是触发一个人的事可能触发也可能不触发另一个人的原因。

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, the same parent ends up becoming an invaluable member of the team.
ex.t: 不知不觉间，同一位家长最终成了球队里不可或缺的一员。

ex.s: They hope paper bags will be banned someday too and want shoppers to use the same reusable bags for years.
ex.t: 他们希望有一天纸袋也会被禁，并希望购物者多年来一直使用同一个可重复使用的袋子。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: They study in the same school.
ex.t: 他们在同一所学校学习。

ex.s: As demand grew, Drewry opened another Sprouts in the same area in 2022.
ex.t: 随着需求增长，德鲁里于2022年在同一地区开了第二家Sprouts。

ex.s: They worked in the same theater.
ex.t: 他们在同一家剧院工作。

ex.s: I learned that Freddy did several jobs after his   52    from high school and remained the same  53    person I met forty years before .Once, while working overnight at a store, he let a homeless man   54   in his truck .
ex.t: 我了解到弗雷迪高中____后做过几份工作，并且仍然是我四十年前认识的那个____53____的人。有一次，他在商店通宵工作时，让一个无家可归的人____54____在他的卡车里。

ex.s: They worked in the same theater.
ex.t: 当一种阔叶植物受到攻击时，它不会安静地坐着。

ex.s: When my English teacher stepped into the classroom, I was surprised to see the same man I had met earlier.
ex.t: 当我的英语老师走进教室时，我惊讶地发现他就是我之前遇到的那个男人。

ex.s: Suddenly, a girl bumped into me - the same girl from the corridor!
ex.t: 突然，一个女孩撞到了我——就是走廊里的那个女孩！

ex.s: I learned that Freddy did several jobs after his   52    from high school and remained the same  53    person I met forty years before.
ex.t: 我得知弗雷迪高中   52   后做过几份工作，仍是四十年前我遇到的那个   53   的人。
